transcript.text: Good morning everyone. We've got the $20 million five-year Northbridge Infrastructure bond tranche to allocate. The current draft has $10 million to Northstar Pension Fund and $10 million to Harbor Insurance. Before I finalize this book, I need risk and institutional sales to report any relevant limits, orders, or execution requirements. Can we walk through where things stand?
